name: OfficeRnD Flex
positioning: The operating system of a coworking business — memberships, bookings, billing and the member app in one product.
description: OfficeRnD Flex manages flexible workspace operations: member and company records, space and desk inventory, contracts and automated recurring billing, meeting room bookings, door access integration, and a member-facing app and portal.
real_estate_use: A flex operator's revenue is a mesh of monthly memberships, day passes, room hours and overage charges — billing that breaks any standard property accounting model. OfficeRnD automates the invoice run and connects it to access control, so a lapsed payment can suspend a badge. Landlords running their own flex floors buy it for the same reason.
features: Membership plans, contracts and automated recurring billing
Desk, office and meeting room inventory and allocation
Member app and portal for bookings and community
Door access control integration tied to membership status

use_cases.job: Bill a mesh of memberships, day passes and room hours without manual invoicing
Operate flexible workspace floors inside an owned building
